name: Kart-O-Drom
evidence: Own site (checked 2026-10-15) has online booking, current opening hours (Thu-Sun, holidays daily), a price list (15 EUR / 10 min) and a weekly Sunday Flatrace; the site code carries 2026 change notes, so it is actively maintained.

name: Kartland Sinn
evidence: No current evidence found: only undated directory listings (Herborner Str. 7-9, 35764 Sinn; one portal says open all year) and no official site or social account; kartland-sinn.de only leads to an outdated club page (2013/2014).

name: Indy-Cart Indoorkartbahn
evidence: Own site (checked 2026-10-15) still shows only 'Wir haben vorübergehend geschlossen' with a 2024 copyright footer, and Freizeitinsider lists it as temporarily closed; no reopening date and no permanent-closure announcement found.

name: Pala Kart Parma
evidence: palakartparma.it still resolves but is a frozen 2013/2014 page (Via Mantova 86A, last notice August 2014); no news of a new location, reopening or permanent closure was found.

The location matches GokartArenan, Horns väg 5, 605 97 Norrköping (indoor and outdoor karting plus segway per an undated Thatsup listing); gokartarenan.se shows 'Squarespace - Website Expired' on 2026-10-15 (ownership not confirmed) and no current posts, news or closure notice were found.

No karting operator, club or news found for the mapped raceway at Sandtorp/Husaby (Götene kommun); only the nearby Kinnekulle Ring car circuit and Götene Motorklubb appear, neither mentioning karting.

name: Euro Dieppe Karting
evidence: Only undated tourism/aggregator listings found (ZA Verte, 76370 Rouxmesnil-Bouteilles, 14:00-20:00, from 12 EUR); no official site, social posts, closure news or 2025-2026 evidence.

name: Ecokart
evidence: OSM gives Ecokart (karting + laser game) at 108 rue Jean Mantelet, Saint-Lô; that address is now the Padel Max complex, whose site (checked 2026-10-15) offers only 5 padel courts and LaserMaxx with no karting, and ecokart.fr no longer resolves, so the building appears converted (conversion date unknown).

name: Royal Kart
evidence: Only undated listings (ZA La Montgervalaise, 35520 La Mézière); Groupon shows 'Fermé' without date or reason and royalkart.com is a for-sale page, but no closure announcement, news or current activity was found.

name: Sport-In Park
evidence: Own site (checked 2026-10-15) lists soccer, padel, squash, badminton/pickleball, bubble foot and archery game but no karting; in a Padel Magazine interview (10 Sep 2024) the manager says they closed the karting track after COVID and a nephew took over operation by renting the space, while tourism listings still mention a 320-330 m kart track, so whether karting still runs is unclear.

name: Kartmania
evidence: OSM tags this point as an office (office=yes), not a track; kartmania.com redirects to a domain-sale page (2026-10-15) and only undated directory entries exist, so there is no current evidence either way.

name: Kartmania - Circuit de l'Auxois Sud
evidence: Only an undated PagesJaunes entry places Kartmania at the Complexe Auxois Sud karting, Maconge; no operator site, 2025-2026 events, posts or closure news were found.

name: KartCenter Sopot
evidence: The operator lists Sopot (Outdoor) among its tracks and its page says the rebuilt track opened on 24 July (2026), consistent with the operator's summer-2026 reopening post; it is an outdoor track that a listing says closes November to March.

name: Kartland
evidence: A dated OSM survey note (StreetComplete, 2025-11-16) says 'Kartland ist dauerhaft geschlossen' and kartland.de now redirects to a casino spam domain (2026-10-15), but no official announcement or news was found, so closure is likely but unconfirmed.

name: Karlskrona Hyrkart
evidence: The OSM website hyrgokart.nu does not resolve (2026-10-15) and searches found no listing, posts or news for a rental kart track at Torskors/Karlskrona.
No karting business, club or news found for this point on Saltö (Utövägen), a mainly residential island in Karlskrona.

name: Kartland Paris
evidence: Own site (checked 2026-10-15) shows today's status ('Fermé aujourd'hui jeudi 15 octobre', open daily except Tue/Thu), the adult track opening on 17-18 October, prices from 24 EUR and a 2026 events programme.

name: Motodrom
evidence: OSM places a karting 'Motodrom' at Bartników, Przewóz (Podgórze); the only other Motodrom found is a driver-training venue at ul. Fabryczna 13 whose site motodromkrakow.pl does not resolve, and no current karting evidence was found.
